explication: WeChat Bot is a command-line IM agent and local-WeChat analysis tool. Its main reply flow is an IM event through a channel agent, optional message capture, a selected AI service, and a reply sent back through that channel. Separate workflows operate Lark messages, invoke OpenCLI for local WeChat data, and analyze chat data with statistics or AI. The README documents these capabilities, but most platform-agent and analysis implementations were not sampled, so their internal call wiring is shown only where documented or evidenced by the CLI excerpt.
